c: Being a Belnades' Spellbook weapon, Keremet Bubbles has a charge time before activation, which is indicated by the brightness of its created magic circle.

Keremet Bubbles summons a green magic circle behind the character at the center end of the screen, its angle can be controlled by the character's movement, starting at the left end of the screen and moving in the direction the character is moving until it reaches the right end of the screen. Once Charged, it fires green bubbles in waves that travel towards the character, damaging enemies they touch and continuing to travel until they eventually pop (affected by
